title: Ticket 1.61.10 — R42 system-wide day/night mode
notes: Adds a persistent, browser-wide day/night preference shared by the main system and the food management panel. The global toggle changes the full page surface, including header/navigation, content, cards, tables, forms, modals, organization view, and footer. It retains the separate user accent-color setting and supports reduced-motion fallback. No cloud dependency or sample data is added to the product.
